verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents OpenAI/Anthropic SDK compatibility, function calling, streaming, JSON mode, rate limits, and even a dedicated agent harness preview, giving AI-native developers a well-documented path to build against official/compatible SDKs. Community evidence corroborates real-world usage (via Cline, OpenRouter, Claude Code integrations) though some users report reliability issues with function calling in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a dedicated first-party SDK package (vs. compatibility layer) and more consistent community confirmation of function-calling reliability.
